sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Contoso Pharmaceuticals ka head office Karachi mein aur ek branch Dubai mein hai. Tamam Azure resources ek Microsoft Entra tenant (contoso.onmicrosoft.com) mein hain. Custom domain contoso.com tenant mein verified hai.

sections.heading: Mojooda environment
sections.body: Do subscriptions, Sub-Prod aur Sub-Dev, management group MG-Contoso ke neeche hain. Users Microsoft Entra Connect ke zariye on-premises Active Directory se sync hote hain. Har user ke paas Microsoft Entra ID P1 licence hai. Mojooda security groups: IT-Admins aur Finance (dono assigned membership wale). Sub-Prod ka resource group RG-Core shared production services host karta hai.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. Sales staff ko un ke department attribute ki buniyad par khud ba khud ek group mein add hona chahiye.
2. Developers ko Sub-Dev ke tamam resources manage karne chahiye lekin woh kisi ko access na de sakein.
3. Kisi bhi subscription mein, aage add hone wali subscriptions samet, West Europe ya UAE North ke bahar koi resource na bane.
4. RG-Core ko ghalti se delete hone se bachaya jaye, jab ke configuration changes ki ijazat rahe.
5. Users jo passwords cloud mein reset karein woh on-premises Active Directory mein wapas likhe jayen.
6. Administrative mehnat kam se kam ho.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Fabrikam Retail apni online shop ek Azure subscription, Sub1, mein chalata hai, jis mein teen resource groups hain: RG-Web (web VMs), RG-Data (databases) aur RG-Shared (networking).

sections.heading: Teams
sections.body: WebOps web servers manage karti hai. DBA team databases manage karti hai aur junior DBAs ko onboard karti hai. Finance cloud ka kharcha track karta hai. Northwind Traders (northwind.com) ka ek bahar ka auditor har teen mahine environment review karta hai.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. WebOps ko RG-Web mein VMs manage karni hain lekin virtual networks nahi badalne.
2. DBA team ko RG-Data ka poora control chahiye, junior DBAs ko access dena samet.
3. Finance ko costs dekhne aur budgets banane hain, lekin resources manage nahi karne.
4. Auditor apne mojooda Northwind credentials se Sub1 mein sab kuch parh sake.
5. Jab monthly kharcha 2,000 USD ke 80% tak pohanche to Finance ko email jaye.
6. Har naye resource group par costcenter tag hona chahiye; is ke baghair banana fail ho.
7. Least privilege ke usool par amal karein.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Litware Media video content banata hai. Is ke Azure resources West Europe mein hain. Lahore mein ek on-premises Windows file server par 20 TB shared documents hain. Users on-premises Active Directory accounts se sign in karte hain jo Microsoft Entra ID mein synced hain.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. Raw video uploads 30 din tak bohat use hote hain, us ke baad kam, aur unhein 5 saal tak kam se kam cost par rakhna hai.
2. West Europe region available na ho tab bhi video data parhne ke qabil rehna chahiye, failover kiye baghair.
3. Partner studios ko Microsoft Entra accounts ke baghair 7 din tak ek container mein files upload karni hain. Access kisi bhi waqt revoke ho sake aur doosre access tokens par asar na pare.
4. Lahore office ko shared documents ka tez local access chahiye, Azure mein central copy ke sath, aur mojooda NTFS permissions kaam karti rehni chahiye.
5. Blob storage internet se pohanch mein na ho. VNet-Prod ki VMs aur VPN se jure on-premises clients phir bhi us tak pohanch sakein.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Northwind Health patient reports ko West Europe mein GPv2 storage account stnwhealth (LRS) ke container "reports" mein block blobs ke taur par store karta hai.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. Reports likhe jane ke baad 7 saal tak badli ya delete na ho sakein (regulatory WORM requirement).
2. Agar koi report ghalti se overwrite ho jaye to pichla content wapas mil sake.
3. Agar koi container ghalti se delete ho jaye to woh 14 din tak wapas mil sake.
4. Reports North Europe mein ek alag analytics storage account mein asynchronously copy hon.
5. Reporting app Azure VM par chalti hai aur use koi secret store kiye baghair reports parhni hain.
6. Data aisi keys se encrypt ho jo Northwind control kare aur revoke kar sake.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Adatum Software customers ke liye ek .NET web app aur container mein packaged raat ka data-processing job chalata hai. Tamam resources West Europe mein hain. VNet-Prod ki ek SQL Server VM app ka database rakhti hai.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. Web app ke naye versions baghair downtime deploy hon, aur naya version pehle 10% asli users ke sath test ho.
2. Web app CPU load par khud scale out ho, 8 instances tak.
3. App custom domain www.adatum.com ko free TLS certificate ke sath use kare.
4. App SQL Server VM tak us ke private IP address par pohanche.
5. Raat ka job taqreeban 30 minute chalta hai; Adatum sirf chalne ke dauran paise dena aur kam se kam infrastructure manage karna chahta hai.
6. Container images private tareeqe se store hon aur North Europe mein replicate hon.
7. Costs kam se kam hon.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Tailspin Toys West Europe mein, jo availability zones support karta hai, resource group RG-Shop mein chaar web VMs aur do SQL Server VMs chalata hai. Development VMs RG-Dev mein chalti hain.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.body:
1. Web tier ko 99.99% VM connectivity SLA milna chahiye.
2. SQL VM disks guest OS ke andar BitLocker se encrypt hon, Tailspin ke key vault mein rakhi keys ke sath.
3. Ek reporting VM North Europe mein move karni hai.
4. Paise bachane ke liye development VMs har shaam khud band hon.
5. Web tier CPU ki buniyad par khud scale ho.
6. Ek VM ki OS disk 128 GB se 256 GB tak barhni chahiye.
